questions.q: What's the weather like where you live?
questions.answer: Hot and humid for much of the year. We have a long summer, then a heavy monsoon from around June, and a short, pleasant winter. The monsoon rain can be [[torrential]], and flooding is common near the river.

questions.q: What kind of weather do you like?
questions.answer: I'm fondest of mild, sunny weather, the kind you get here in winter. It's warm enough to be comfortable but not stifling, so you can actually enjoy being outside. The intense summer heat I find rather [[oppressive]].
Winter, easily. It's short here but lovely, with cool, pleasant days and clear skies. It's the season when I feel most [[energetic]] and want to be out and about, so I always look forward to it.

questions.q: Does the weather affect your daily plans?
questions.answer: Quite a bit, actually. The rainy season here can be [[relentless]], so I often check the forecast before heading out. On a pleasant, sunny day I'm far more likely to go out and do something active.

questions.q: Has the weather in your country changed in recent years?
questions.answer: People certainly feel it has. Summers seem hotter and longer, and the rains are less predictable than they used to be. My grandfather often says the seasons have become far more [[erratic]] than in his youth.
